programme_name: Master's degree in Biology for Translational Research and Precision Medicine
admission_type_official_wording: Limited-entry degree programme based on qualifications

admission_routes.notes: Apply through ESSE3, upload the call documents, pay the EUR 50 selection fee, and qualify in the ranking.
Uses the selection call subject to legal-equivalence classification.
A separate foreign-qualification assessment applies and 5 places are reserved; visa candidates also require Universitaly. Exact pre-admission timing was not independently retrieved. [uncertain]

academic_requirements.summary: Applicants need an L-13, L-2 or SNT/03 bachelor's degree (or suitable equivalent) with at least 90/110, or alternatively a weighted exam average of at least 24/30 with at least 80% of programme credits completed. Applicants from other degree classes need 60 CFU in BIO, CHIM and/or MED fields, including 24 CFU in specified BIO fields. Non-EU applicants abroad are additionally described as needing a relevant biological, chemical, biophysical or bioinformatics degree and a credit-weighted average above 81%.
academic_requirements.eligible_foreign_qualifications: A suitable equivalent foreign qualification. For non-EU residents abroad, the official page lists first-cycle-or-higher degrees in biological disciplines (biotechnology, biochemistry, molecular biology, biology), chemical disciplines, biophysics or bioinformatics.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.notes: For applicants from degree classes other than L-13, L-2 or SNT/03.

minimum_credits_by_subject_area.subject_area_or_ssd: BIO/06, BIO/09, BIO/10, BIO/11, BIO/13, BIO/18, BIO/19

academic_requirements.minimum_grade_or_gpa: L-13/L-2/SNT/03: at least 90/110, or weighted exam average at least 24/30 with at least 80% of credits completed. Non-EU-abroad route: CGPA or equivalent above 81%.
academic_requirements.curriculum_assessment: A committee checks the qualification, curriculum and personal preparation; only eligible candidates enter the ranking.

ranking_and_quota.ranking_details: Admission is by qualifications without an admission test. Eligible candidates are ranked using degree grade or weighted examination average; enrolment depends on ranking position.

selection_components.component: Degree grade or weighted examination average
selection_components.weight_or_threshold: At least 90/110, or at least 24/30 with 80% of credits completed
selection_components.notes: Forms the basis of the merit ranking.

accepted_language_certificates: UNIVR CLA B2 receptive-skills entrance test for eligible external applicants
certificate_exemptions: Qualifying degree formally documented as taught in English
B2 English proficiency/exam recorded in a previous university career with the level clearly indicated
language_requirements.notes: A programme-specific CLA test was scheduled for 28 July 2026 at 10:00; registration closed 10 July 2026.

entry_exam_or_test.mode: Selection by qualifications; no admission test

entry_exam_or_test.notes: The English test is evidence of language proficiency, not the competitive admission test. The programme selection itself is document-based.

application_fee.notes: Selection registration fee paid via PagoPA.

tuition_amount_basis: First instalment EUR 358; second and third instalments variable under the annual university fees schedule and ISEE/ISEE-equivalent rules.
